correctness.rationale: Every q odd >=3: locally finite Walnut identity and 2-periodic unitary Bloch decomposition yield the stated 2-by-2 matrix. The four coefficient sums are exact rational polynomials, and strict monotonicity follows from the identity R(w)^2-(5-2q^2+3w)^2=24(q^2-1)>0. At w=0 and w=1 the lower/upper spectral extrema are achieved as essential limits. CHECK.py replay verified 773 finite assertions including direct Zak fibers; the infinite theorem is proved analytically.
